description: Structured schema for storing voice screening transcript segments.

candidate_id.description: Unique identifier assigned to the candidate.

job_id.description: Unique identifier assigned to the job.

question_id.description: Unique identifier of the screening question.

timestamp.description: Timestamp associated with the transcript segment.

confidence_level.description: Confidence score associated with the speech-to-text transcription.

speaker.description: Identifies the speaker of the transcript segment.

transcript_text.description: Normalized text converted from the spoken voice interaction.
transcript_text.example: I have two years of experience in Python.
